observation_indicators.observable_fil: Ihiwalay ang alam sa unknown, bumuo ng specific question sa tamang contact, ulitin at linawin ang sagot, at tukuyin ang bounded next step.
observation_indicators.observable_en: Distinguish facts from unknowns, form a specific question through the appropriate contact, repeat and clarify the response, and identify a bounded next step.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Patuloy na ipinapalagay ang approval o sanhi, o wala pang specific question at clarification matapos ang suporta; magmodelo at ulitin.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Still assumes approval or cause, or cannot yet form a specific question and clarification after support; model and repeat.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Naipapakita ang lahat ng kilos sa dalawang staff card nang walang prompt.
levels.kaya_na_en: Demonstrates every action on two staff cards without prompts.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Tamang direksiyon, may prompt sa facts, question, clarification o next step.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Sound direction, with prompts for facts, question, clarification or next step.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: May unconfirmed assumption o kulang na question/clarification matapos ang suporta; kailangan ng model at re-practice.
levels.hindi_pa_en: An unconfirmed assumption or missing question/clarification remains after support; needs modelling and re-practice.
